investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Vellane Pay (digital banking); Platform: AWS ca-central-1 (zones ca-central-1a/ca-central-1b/ca-central-1d); network range 10.218.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster vellan-prod-cacent (EKS); Edge: provider-managed load balancer (edge-lb) in front of mobile-bff backends; a standby load balancer exists in a secondary region; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
